# NPR

> NPR is a comprehensive news and media platform delivering breaking news, investigative journalism, and cultural commentary across politics, science, business, health, and entertainment.

NPR serves as a primary source for U.S. and international news coverage, featuring in-depth reporting on major political events, Middle East conflicts, climate change, and cultural topics. The site also offers curated newsletters, podcasts, and specialized sections covering books, film, television, and performing arts.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- Politics & Elections
- Middle East Conflict
- Iran-Israel Conflict
- National News
- World News
- Health & Science
- Climate Change
- Business & Markets
- Podcasts
- Book Reviews
- Pop Culture
- Arts & Entertainment
- Food & Nutrition
- Code Switch

## Breaking News & Core News Coverage

- [NPR Homepage](https://www.npr.org): NPR homepage with breaking news, politics, and multi-topic coverage
- [News: U.S. and World News Headlines](https://www.npr.org/sections/news): NPR news section with breaking stories, headlines, and world coverage
- [U.S. News and National Top Stories](https://www.npr.org/sections/national): NPR national news coverage of U.S. politics, elections, and domestic stories
- [World News and International Headlines](https://www.npr.org/sections/world): NPR world news and international headlines with global affairs coverage

## Politics & Government

- [Politics](https://www.npr.org/sections/politics): NPR politics section covering Congress, White House, and elections

## Science, Health & Environment

- [Health](https://www.npr.org/sections/health): NPR health section covering wellness, policy, and health reporting
- [Science](https://www.npr.org/sections/science): NPR science section with medical advances, research, and health updates
- [Climate](https://www.npr.org/sections/climate): NPR climate section covering climate change and environmental policy

## Business & Economics

- [Business and Financial News](https://www.npr.org/sections/business): NPR business news covering Wall Street, markets, and financial reporting

## Arts, Culture & Entertainment

- [Culture](https://www.npr.org/sections/culture): NPR culture section with arts, entertainment, and visual art coverage
- [Books: Book Reviews, Book News, and Author Interviews](https://www.npr.org/books): NPR books section featuring reviews, author interviews, and recommendations
- [Movies: Movie Reviews and Commentary on New and Classic Films](https://www.npr.org/sections/movies): NPR movies section with film reviews and filmmaker interviews
- [Television](https://www.npr.org/sections/television): NPR television section covering TV series, reviews, and entertainment
- [Pop Culture](https://www.npr.org/sections/pop-culture): NPR pop culture section with entertainment news and commentary
- [Performing Arts](https://www.npr.org/sections/performing-arts): NPR performing arts section with theater, dance, and music coverage
- [Art & Design](https://www.npr.org/sections/art-design): NPR art and design section covering visual arts and architecture

## Lifestyle & Food

- [Food](https://www.npr.org/sections/food): NPR food section with recipes, nutrition, and food policy coverage

## Newsletters & Special Coverage

- [NPR Newsletters](https://www.npr.org/newsletters): NPR newsletter directory featuring email subscriptions and content discovery
- [Code Switch Blog](https://www.npr.org/sections/codeswitch): Code Switch blog exploring race, identity, and civil rights topics
